name: Explore projects and filter the portfolio
description: Verifies a visitor can reach projects, filter the list and open a repository link.
steps: Select the Software filter and then All
expected: The project list updates to match the selected filter, and project repository links are available.

name: Use the navigation on a mobile screen
description: Verifies the navigation menu works on mobile and selecting a section closes the menu.
steps: Open the portfolio at a mobile viewport
expected: The mobile navigation is displayed, About is reached, and the menu closes.

name: Contact the portfolio owner
description: Verifies the contact section provides usable email and profile links.
expected: The browser opens an email compose action addressed to bentiger255@gmail.com.

name: Open legal information and skip repeated navigation
description: Verifies legal pages are reachable and keyboard users can bypass repeated navigation.
steps: Open the portfolio at a mobile viewport
Activate Skip to content using keyboard navigation
Open Privacy from the footer and then open Terms
expected: The main content receives focus, and both legal pages load with responsive readable content.
